name: CP-132,484
summary: CP-132,484, also known as 4,5-dihydropyrano-1-methyltryptamine (4,5-DHP-1-Me-T), is a tryptamine derivative which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT2 family of serotonin receptors. It has reasonable selectivity for 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C subtypes over 5-HT2B, but is only slightly selective for 5-HT2A over 5-HT2C.
